meta.title: Modern Luxury Bedroom 1 (4.9m x 4.0m) - King Bed, TV Wall and Lounge Nook

physical_properties.bed: king size (approx. 1.83m x 2.03m mattress) upholstered bed with tall channel-tufted ivory boucle headboard mounted on a freestanding walnut-panelled headboard wall, slim low-profile frame, bed floating in the middle of the room
physical_properties.bedding: crisp white sateen sheets, champagne silk-look duvet folded back at the foot, layered euro shams and two lumbar pillows in taupe velvet, chunky knit throw draped at an angle
physical_properties.nightstand: two walnut veneer nightstands, about 0.5m wide each, with fluted drawer fronts, brushed brass pulls and travertine tops
physical_properties.lamp: sculptural ceramic table lamp with pleated linen shade, switched off
physical_properties.finish: rich mix of matte, velvet, boucle and brushed metal textures

midground.notes: stack of two coffee-table books, small brass tray with a glass carafe, a bud vase with a single white ranunculus, a slim gold alarm clock
sculptural taupe boucle lounge chair, round travertine side table with a cup of coffee and an open book, slim brass arc floor lamp

background.notes: freestanding walnut-panelled half-height wall with integrated warm LED strip along the top edge (off), glimpse of the doorway to the ensuite visible past one end
floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors with sheer ivory curtains and greige linen drapes pulled open; glimpse of balcony and soft greenery beyond
small blown-glass pendants on brass rods, off
65 inch slim TV, screen off, on fluted walnut panelling above a floating walnut TV unit with soft LED glow underneath

surface.details: wide-plank light oak floor with a plush cream wool rug under the bed

background.texture: limewash plaster wall in warm greige

palette.notes: ivory, greige and taupe base with champagne brass, walnut and a touch of deep slate

atmosphere.mood: serene, elegant, boutique-hotel calm on a fresh morning

camera.focus_point: whole room: king bed in the foreground and center, TV wall on the right, lounge nook and balcony doors on the left
camera.position: standing just inside the entry door in the north-east corner, looking diagonally south-west across the room toward the corner where the TV wall meets the south glass doors

lighting.key_light_source: morning sunlight through the balcony sliding doors, filtered by sheer curtains
lighting.notes: soft sunbeams falling across the bedding, gentle shadows, no artificial lights on

style.rendering: photorealistic interior photography, architectural digest editorial quality

room_layout.bed_wall: king bed centered north-south in the room, headboard on the east side facing west toward the TV
room_layout.window_wall: south wall (4.0m): wide floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors to a balcony; to the bed's left as you lie in it
room_layout.entry_door: 0.9m wide door in the north wall at the north-east corner, hinged on the east side and swinging into the room; its swing stays clear of the north end of the headboard wall
room_layout.ensuite_opening: 0.9m wide opening in the east wall between the two walk-in robes, leading to the ensuite; hidden behind the freestanding headboard wall
room_layout.clearances: east-west across 4.0m: 0.7m walkway + 0.1m headboard wall + about 2.15m king bed + about 0.75m walkway + 0.3m TV unit; north-south along 4.9m: about 1.0m between each nightstand end and the north/south walls, about 1.45m between the sides of the bed and the north/south walls
room_layout.headboard_feature_wall: freestanding headboard wall 1.2m high, 0.1m thick and about 2.9m long (bed plus two nightstands), set 0.7m west of the robes/ensuite opening and centered north-south, leaving about 1.0m clear at each end for access to the robes and ensuite
room_layout.opposite_wall: the long left wall facing the foot of the bed: floating TV wall with a 65 inch TV centered on the bed

tv_wall.tv: 65 inch ultra-slim TV (approx. 1.45m wide x 0.83m tall), flush wall-mounted, screen center about 1.1m above the floor for viewing from bed, screen off showing a dark glossy surface
tv_wall.backdrop: vertical fluted walnut panelling about 2.4m wide behind the TV, with a soft warm LED wash from above
tv_wall.floating_unit: wall-hung walnut TV module about 2.2m wide, 0.3m deep and 0.3m high, centered on the 4.9m west wall, floating about 0.35m above the floor with hidden LED glow underneath, push-to-open fronts, travertine top styled with a small sculpture and a low ceramic bowl

room_layout.lounge_nook: south-west corner, between the end of the TV unit and the south glass doors: sculptural taupe boucle lounge chair angled toward the view, round travertine side table, slim brass floor lamp, small round wool rug
room_layout.orientation: room runs north-south; west wall (TV wall) 4.9m long, north and south walls 4.0m; east side is the robes and ensuite opening
